name: orchestration-mode
description: Shows which Task Orchestrator orchestration mode this session is in (today: director): a footer label, a run board above the prompt, a tinted desktop backdrop and enter/exit toasts (early-access function-hooks API)

backdrop.title: Director backdrop
backdrop.description: Tint the desktop app's backdrop while this session is in director mode. The footer label and toasts show either way.

apiUrl.title: Task Orchestrator REST API URL
apiUrl.description: Base URL of the server's REST API; the band's run board reads POST <apiUrl>/api/v1/ops/director/<tool>. Leave empty to read over the director MCP connection instead (stdio servers).
